name: span-tree
title: SpanTree
description: Accessible, controllable tree of trace spans with full WAI-ARIA APG TreeView semantics (treeitem/level/posinset/setsize/selected/expanded/group), keyboard navigation (↑/↓/Home/End/Enter), a dual recursive/virtualized render path, an optional inline timeline bar, and per-kind badges. Fully controlled selection + collapse.
